risks.title: Dependence on weather conditions and seasonality
risks.score_rationale: This risk is cited at the beginning of the 'Risk Factors' section (item 1) and mentioned multiple times, underscoring its importance for revenues. The intensity of language ('adversely affect', 'significant impact') and context (strong seasonal dependence) justify a high severity rating.

risks.title: Energy transition and decline in fossil fuel demand
risks.score_rationale: This risk is presented as a major consequence of the transition toward a low-carbon economy, with regulations ('regulatory responses', 'laws and regulations') and technological advances ('technological advances') that reduce demand for fossil products. The potential impact is deemed existential for the current business model.

risks.title: Volatility of energy commodity prices
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly mentions 'volatile fluctuations' in propane and natural gas prices. Price timing gaps ('time lags') between purchase and resale can result in 'significant gross margin fluctuations', directly impacting profitability.

risks.title: Risks related to acquisitions and strategic integration
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed with numerous sub-points (liabilities, management distraction, cultural/system integration, overpayment). The failure of these strategic transactions is explicitly linked to negative impact on 'business, cash flows, financial condition and results of operations'.

risks.title: Competition from alternative energy sources
risks.score_rationale: Risk of competition from other energy sources (electricity, natural gas) is clearly identified. While electricity is often more expensive, climate policies favoring renewable electricity ('climate change policies favoring electricity from renewable energy sources') could shift this balance.

risks.title: Physical impacts of climate change
risks.score_rationale: The text mentions 'physical effects of climate change' such as increased frequency of storms, flooding, etc., which could disrupt operations and supply chains, incurring significant costs ('significant costs').

risks.title: Complex and unpredictable government regulations
risks.score_rationale: This risk is underscored by the phrase 'comprehensive, complex, and sometimes unpredictable governmental regulations'. Such regulations may increase costs and limit revenue growth ('increase our costs and limit our revenue growth').
